english: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
text: in reasonable condition 是保存状态还不错，不是‘在合理条件下’。评价旧物是否值得修复时，可把状态 in good/poor condition 与价值 worth restoring 分开说；状态尚好也不等于完好如新。
